notes: All values come from pages opened or seen in search results on 2026-11-15. 'trust': report = press/analyst report, platform = the platform's own terms or data, index = published index, estimate = third-party guide or a figure we derived from sourced inputs (derivation stated in 'note'). volatility is null everywhere: no published annualised volatility was found for these markets. FX: GBP/USD 1.3232 (OFX live rate, 2026-11-13, https://www.ofx.com/en-us/exchange-rates/gbp-to-usd/).

time_to_sell.text: Chrono24 escrow releases funds after delivery plus an inspection window: about 7 days for private sellers, 14 days for dealers, then a few business days of bank transfer
time_to_sell.note: Covers shipping to payout only. Time to find a buyer is not included. The 28-day upper bound is our estimate (14-day dealer window plus shipping and bank transfer).

time_to_sell.text: Consignment deadlines are about 2-3 months before a sale, and Sotheby's pays within 45 days of the sale (Christie's and Bonhams 35 days). Guides put first contact to payment at roughly 4-7 months
time_to_sell.source: Sotheby's fee structure page; Spear's (Apr 2026); secondary seller guides
time_to_sell.note: The low bound is ours (60-day lead time plus 45-day payout). The high bound is the 7-month figure from secondary guides.

min_ticket.text: Masterworks standard minimum about $15,000 per offering. Reviews say it is sometimes lowered to about $2,500 after an advisor call
min_ticket.source: InvestorMint Masterworks review 2026 (secondary)

max_drawdown.source: Masterworks Insights, 'What happens to art during a recession'

exit_cost.text: Sotheby's seller's commission is 10% on the first $500,000 of hammer per lot and 0% above that (waived above $5m low estimate). The buyer separately pays a premium of up to 28%, which lowers what they will bid
exit_cost.note: Excludes insurance, shipping and the 4% guarantee fee when it applies.

time_to_sell.text: Vinovest liquidation is 15-30 days on average per one review, 4-6 weeks per another, and up to 8-12 weeks per a third. Vinovest itself guarantees no timeline
time_to_sell.source: Vinovest reviews (secondary) summarised in search results

min_ticket.text: Vinovest entry tier $1,000. A 2026 review says the managed-portfolio minimum rose to $5,000, and whisky casks start around $1,750
min_ticket.source: Vinovest reviews (The Ways To Wealth; Angel Investors Network 2026)

max_drawdown.period: Sep 2022 peak to Aug 2025 (Liv-ex Fine Wine 100)

exit_cost.text: Vinovest charges 1% to sell to another user on its marketplace, a 3% early-sale fee within the early window, and nothing when it sells wine in its optimal window
exit_cost.note: Excludes the 2.25-2.85% yearly management fee, the buy-side fee and the bid-ask spread.

time_to_sell.text: Bring a Trailer: submission to approval 2-4 weeks, listing prep 1-2 weeks, then a 7-day auction. 2025 sell-through was 81.8%
time_to_sell.note: Payment is settled between buyer and seller after the auction. The low bound is ours (2 + 1 weeks).
